subject: FYI: tests/qbank/test_qbank_db.py::test_only_the_qbank_and_the_seed_read_answer_columns fails on claude/naadi-shared (authoring modules)
body: On the current shared tip the db test lists authoring/{lint,review_store,routes,prompts,models,store,checks}.py as modules that mention answer columns; the test's allowlist needs your authoring package (or the reads moved behind qbank). Not touched by S18.
